evidence: Modifies LoadBlockIndex logic handling m_blocks_unlinked and fixes a block-index invariant assertion crash (#35050).
rationale: Fixes an assertion crash during node startup and block connection when running with -checkblockindex on pruned nodes. 'For pruned blocks whose parents are header-only, this causes the CheckBlockIndex invariant (!foundInUnlinked) to fail assertions on startup or during block connection, crashing nodes running with -checkblockindex'.
